claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Terazosin at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent; its only annotated activity is alpha1-adrenergic receptor antagonism, which does not kill cancer cells, and no known off-target cytotoxic mechanism (e.g., cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress) is expected at this concentration.
